title: Kissed Juicy Dutch Poppy Seeds Dumplings
description: A traditional Dutch dish featuring ground poppy seeds, these dumplings are cooked in a bain-marie to create a fatty and juicy treat, rich in anti-inflammatory properties. Perfect for special occasions and festivals.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground poppy seeds, flour, and granulated sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, whole milk, eggs, salt, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the dumplings in a bain-marie and cook for 20 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the bain-marie and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the dumplings warm, garnished with powdered sugar if desired.
